title: These firms you've never heard of are feeding fears the AI bubble could burst

evidence.quote: Analysts at Gartner predict by 2030, 80% of neocloud firms will "cease independent operations"

evidence.quote: One outlier is Nebius, which was known as Yandex NV when it was part of Russia's version of Google before splitting off and changing its name in 2024.

claims.claim: Hazine Bakanı Scott Bessent Perşembe günü CNBC'de neocloud firmalarını genel ekosistemin küçük ve harici bir bileşeni olarak nitelendirdi.

evidence.quote: On Thursday, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent tried to downplay recent concerns about neocloud firms, calling them "a small component of the overall ecosystem, external" on CNBC.

claims.claim: Microsoft, güç kaynağı sorunları nedeniyle İngiliz neocloud firması Nscale ile olan bir anlaşmayı iptal etmiştir.

evidence.quote: Microsoft recently cancelled a deal with a British neocloud outfit called Nscale amid power supply issues which could last through to 2030.

evidence.quote: while Forrester's experts expect at least three of them to be imminently acquired "as finances get shaky".
